about: Insert: the hand pushing the disk in (high-passed above the hum, lifted 10 dB), the latch click at 0.87 s, the clunk onto the spindle at 1.59 s, at the recording's own pace. Eject: the pop at 0.15 s, the hand pulling it out at 1.78 s. trimLead: playback starts at the first sound within that many dB of the clip's peak (the barely audible lead-in is cut) and the timing marks of that clip (insert*, eject*) move with it. Machine sounds: clips cut by tools/make_sfx.mjs from Devon's licensed Epidemic Sound recordings in vendor/sounds_epidemic/ (not in git; never commit them). Times in seconds, found with tools/analyse_audio.mjs: onsets, loudness and spectra (clicks are broadband transients, the drive's head steps cluster at 1-3 kHz, the running machine is a steady low hum).
